name: The Odyssey Of Odyssea
source:
A Kinetic Novel story about the legendary Odyssea (Odysseus gender-bend) finding her way back home to Ithica while going through losses, and fights with her "trustworthy" companions.

[From [url=https://imuniv.itch.io/the-odyssey-of-odyssea]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部动感小说，讲述了传奇人物奥德赛（奥德修斯性别弯曲）在经历失落的过程中寻找回到伊西卡家园的道路，并与她“值得信赖”的同伴战斗的故事。

[来自[url=https://imuniv.itch.io/the-odyssey-of-odyssea]itch.io[/url]]
